title: AdaGATE: Adaptive Gap-Aware Token-Efficient Evidence Assembly for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Yilin Guo; Yinshan Wang; Yixuan Wang
why_relevant: Proposes a training-free controller for multi-hop RAG that handles noisy and redundant retrieval via gap-aware evidence repair and token-budgeted selection, evaluated under noise and redundancy injection.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses narrowly on multi-hop evidence assembly; not a primary robustness/conflict/adversarial work.
suggested_section: Noisy retrieval and evidence selection controllers
